actual_observations: Five adjacent panels share blue square-marked lines and red dashed horizontal CoT baselines.
Y-ranges differ substantially: PubMedQA spans roughly 30–70 whereas MedQA-US spans 61–67.
X ticks visibly read 2e1, 2e3, 2e5; the text defines k as powers of two from 1 to 64.
Several curves fall at their final point; PubMedQA declines as context grows overall.
visual_evidence.scope: Complete original figure, including all panels; crops are children, never counted as additional cases

scientific_task.question: How does the number of retrieved snippets change benchmark accuracy under a fixed system?
scientific_task.supported_claim: Snippet-count sensitivity differs across five QA tasks for GPT-3.5 with RRF-4 and MedCorp.
cannot_conclude: Not a universal monotonic scaling law or guaranteed benefit from more retrieval.
Curves do not measure retrieval recall, answer citation correctness or clinical benefit.

design_analysis.layout: Small multiples preserve task-specific trends without forcing incompatible ranges onto a shared axis. Line-plus-marker separates observations from the horizontal baseline.
design_analysis.axes: Horizontal arrangement supports shape comparison, but different y scales prevent visual slope magnitude comparison.
design_analysis.uncertainty: No error bars or bands shown; do not invent them.

transferable_rules: Use actual k labels such as 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64 rather than ambiguous exponential formatting.
Keep a comparator in every panel and disclose differing y limits.
Use the publication for design learning; reconstruct results only from authorized numerical input, not approximate pixel reading presented as exact data.
nontransferable_content: Do not transfer peak k, numeric accuracy, or blue curve shape to another RAG system.
Do not convert plotted aggregates to individual predictions, confidence intervals or ROC curves.
limitations_and_ambiguities: Figure omits a shared y-axis title; caption and evaluation section resolve accuracy.
Numeric curve values were not transcribed; this case is source interpretation, not experimental reproduction.
